This is not the end of our program. It will continue to be upgraded, and users who purchase will continue to benefit.

notes.title: What is Cutie Cats?
notes.notes:
The CutieCats start talking about five street cats becoming human beings by eating the same thing as the Cutie Marble.

Cats practice and sing to become K-pop stars that they longed for before they became human beings. They end up on stage and send the message to people all over the world, 'Don't abandon your pet.'

Their collaborators developed the program as the beginning of a huge journey. : )

notes.title: Program Launch and User's Guide
notes.notes:
The 2D Vtuber Cutiecats program allows you to quickly produce personal content through convenient setting and recording.

The 'Custom' button on the left side of the first screen allows you to set characters, backgrounds, lip sync files, and the 'Guide' on the right side of the screen to check the expression shortcut, record guide, and end button.

If you press a button on the camcorder graphic in the center of the screen, the recording will run immediately. During recording, the screen will have a red border. When you press the button again, the recording ends and the image file is created where you are guided to the Record Guide.

Please use it a lot. Thank you.

*Path to saving your movie : Documents\2DVtuber_Cutiecats
